title: Search request
description: One benchmark question, as the runner sends it to an adapter. No field ever names the incident.

id.description: Stable question id, e.g. UKR-2026-10-19 (conflict country-week) or WK037 (one non-conflict item).

mode.description: monitor: what happened here this week; topic: what {topic} happened around a date; list: every {category} in a country-week; lookup: a named incident (planned).

query.description: The natural-language question a person would type.

keyword_query.description: The same question as a short keyword query, for services whose guidance prefers keywords.

intent.description: One sentence on what a good answer contains. Useful as a goal field or a prompt.

max_results.description: Depth the run was configured with (--max-results).
